name: Real-Time Vehicle Telemetry Pipeline
short_description: C++ producer sends simulated vehicle telemetry data via ZeroMQ, Python consumer processes and stores it in PostgreSQL. Includes anomaly detection and alerting.
detailed_description: C++ producer sends simulated vehicle telemetry data via ZeroMQ, Python consumer processes and stores it in PostgreSQL. Includes anomaly detection and alerting.

software: Built with C++, Python, ZeroMQ, PostgreSQL, Linux
